definitions.explanation: The measurement of something from end to end; the extent of something along its greatest dimension.

examples.japanese: この{紐|ひも}の{長|なが}さは2メートルだ。
examples.english: The length of this string is 2 meters.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}の{長|なが}さを{測|はか}る。
examples.english: To measure the length of hair.

notes:
{長|なが}さ is derived from the adjective {長|なが}い (long) + the suffix 〜さ, which turns adjectives into nouns expressing degree or measurement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長|なが}さを{測|はか}る: to measure the length
- {長|なが}さが{足|た}りない: the length is not enough
- {長|なが}さを{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust the length

SIMILAR MEASUREMENT NOUNS (adjective + さ):
- {高|たか}さ: height (from {高|たか}い)
- {深|ふか}さ: depth (from {深|ふか}い)
- {広|ひろ}さ: area, spaciousness (from {広|ひろ}い)
- {厚|あつ}さ: thickness (from {厚|あつ}い)
- {重|おも}さ: weight (from {重|おも}い)

NOTE:
{長|なが}さ refers to spatial length, time duration, or abstract extent (e.g., {文章|ぶんしょう}の{長|なが}さ = the length of a text).
